mapper.sql: id, title, content, images, user_id, status, is_deleted, audit_reason, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into cms_forum_post (title, content, images, user_id, status, is_deleted, audit_reason, create_time, update_time) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{userId}, #{status}, 0, #{auditReason}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update cms_forum_post set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from cms_forum_post where is_deleted = 0 and status = 0 order by create_time asc
